ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Utinni — Fire Ecology (Pyrelands)
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description: Wires `mandrake.rsw.fireecology`'s generic desert fire-ecology engine onto THIS campaign's Pyrelands biome (`ZBiome_Grasslands`, from "More Vanilla Biomes" — zylle.morevanillabiomes): strips rain, cranks DryThunderstorm, adds Black Rain to the biome's weather table, swaps its ground terrain for the scorchable/ash-ladder family, and seeds scorch-fruit's spawn odds. FIRE_ECOLOGY_LOOP_1's v1 slice, per `infrastructure/state/items/FIRE_ECOLOGY_LOOP_1.md`.
